response.query: Where will we pre-register primary/secondary outcomes, analysis/modeling family, and publication plan, and can the CAB review participant-facing materials before the pilot?
response.answer: Pre-register primary/secondary outcomes, analysis/modeling family, and publication plans typically on clinicaltrials.gov or similar platforms. CAB review of participant-facing materials before the pilot is often possible but should be confirmed with the specific study protocol.

results.content: Skip to contentSkip to site index The Upshot The Upshot|Office of Management and Budget Spreadsheet of 2,600 Federal Programs Under Review https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2025/01/29/upshot/trump-omb-spreadsheet.html Advertisement SKIP ADVERTISEMENT # Office of Management and Budget Spreadsheet of 2,600 Federal Programs Under Review After ordering temporary freezes in “all federal financial assistance” on Jan. 27, the White House Office of Management and Budget sent this document providing instructions on how to comply with the order to government agencies, listing about 2,600 programs that were under review. Instructions for Federal Financial Assistance Program Analysis in Support of M-25-13 All Federal agencies that provide Federal financial assistance are required by February 7, 2025 to complete the attached spreadsheet and submit it to OMB. Using the spreadsheet provided, locate or filter the spreadsheet to isolate the agency's list of Federal programs (by Assistance Listing number) and complete the requested information for each program (represented in columns C-G). Agencies should add additional lines to the spreadsheet to include any programs not listed in the spreadsheet. Advertisement SKIP ADVERTISEMENT
